text.p: Italian bond futures held slightly firmer in late afternoon with all eyes on the FOMC meeting which may raise U.S. rates and the first batch of preliminary May Italian CPI data from five Italian cities, dealers said.

With the FOMC meeting underway and the CPI figures expected at 1530 GMT, most players were holding on to see if the former might rise U.S. interest rates while the latter might trigger a cut in Italian interest rates.
Dealers say the Bank of Italy could cut its 6.75 percent discount rate soon if CPI data came in as expected at around 1.5 percent year on year after April's 1.7 percent rate.

The BTP rally narrowed the spread between the benchmark February 2007 fixed rate Italian government bond (BTP) and the benchmark July 2007 German bund to record levels, and was last quoted at 135 basis points.
